Use retained weak identity plus original is-checks, not hashing a credential whose bearer is scrubbed, not raw object-id equality or matching opaque hashes.
context_state.after_submit_expiry: No new context operation or new registration attempt is automatically minted. If a lost ACK leaves no client-known coordinate, report unknown/unavailable rather than infer success or recover via a new UUID.
context_state.restart: All old handles/ref become unknown; no context tombstone import or replacement owner. Normal startup has no admitted purpose; original real enrollment/purpose service admission must be re-established independently. This cannot reset an issuer/service persisted attempt budget.
